Body page of the SoftBank Group release PDF, page 2. Headline "WeWork Announces Significant Funding from SoftBank Group", subheads about a finance package combining debt and equity and about the Board electing Marcelo Claure as Executive Chairman, dateline NEW YORK and TOKYO, October 22, 2019, top. Body: $5 billion new financing, tender offer up to $3 billion for existing shareholders, acceleration of the existing $1.5 billion commitment; after closing and tender, SoftBank fully diluted economic ownership about 80%; WeWork will not be a subsidiary but an associate of SoftBank; Board appoints Marcelo Claure as Executive Chairman, Adam Neumann becomes a Board observer. Combined package 5 + 3 + 1.5 = 9.5 billion USD.
